flashcard_questions.q: Which 1965 law transformed Black voter registration in the American South?
Black voter registration in Mississippi rose from 6.7% to ____.
How many Black elected officials were there by 1973, up from fewer than 100?
Which year did American women gain the vote through the 19th Amendment?
Which 1963 law required equal pay for women doing the same work as men?
Which 1972 law gave women equal access to education?
Which 1973 Supreme Court ruling gave American women the right to abortion?
Black family income was only ____ of white family income in 1970.
Compared with around 10% of white Americans, what share of Black Americans lived below the poverty line?
How much did women earn for every dollar earned by men by 1973?
Which 1944 law sent millions of American veterans to college?
Which 1971 organisation worked to get more American women elected?
What term describes the belief that anyone in America can succeed through hard work?
What approach to the economy did American government follow in the 1920s?

notes: 14 cards: 6 law-or-ruling to name, 5 statistic, 2 cloze on figures, 1 term to definition. This is an overview lesson, so cards lean on the hard numbers and the named legislation rather than the balanced-judgement prose, which is essay material, not flashcard material.
